explanation:
The central tree retains the boundary's major components and contracts while reducing the seed from 147 to 102 lines (30.6%) and from 10,965 to 7,505 characters (31.6%). Six peripheral trees expand composition, MCP scope, HTTP admission, chat streaming, live sockets and evaluation. [M] denotes modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership and [D] data dependency; these perspectives can coexist within each tree. Edges attach to the corresponding central concept lines. Positions leave gaps between the measured text bounds.

Only context.json and seed.json supply evidence. Composition details come from bootstrap.ts; MCP details from infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts and scripts/mapping/mcp.ts; admission from vitePlugin.ts, apiAccess.ts, http.ts and agentRoutes.ts; streaming from agentChatRoutes.ts and liveCanvasRoutes.ts; evaluation from evalRoutes.ts and the mapping router.

Corrections and qualifications: the seed's broad public-session/event filtering claim is narrowed to the explicit publicSession/publicEvent paths; list and generations routes delegate directly, so their filtering cannot be inferred here. The socket implementation permits errors before successful attach/publish, rather than enforcing that the first validated frame selects a role. Fake mode switches selected runtimes, while Agent Chat still receives StdioCodexConnection and diff workflows receive PiDiffSessionRuntime. Diagram-tool validation without a chat binding also applies to target-bound connections, so 'unbound' was too ambiguous.

New source-grounded details include context-source resolution, the distinction between MCP readOnlyHint and HTTP gate exemptions, extra MCP callbacks omitting the binding header, precise snapshot shortening, weak/wildcard ETag matching, and evaluation input dependencies. Imported service implementations and schemas are not supplied; delegation does not establish their internal validation, persistence or authorization behavior.

|   |-- [C] WebSocket upgrade: /api/mapping/live
|   |   |-- Origin absent or Origin host equals request Host; otherwise reject with 403
|   |   |-- At 1024 clients -> reject with 503; incoming payload limit 8 MiB

|   |       `-- publish(workspaceInstanceId) -> browser publisher -> publisher.ready

|   |-- Diff workflows still receive PiDiffSessionRuntime

|-- [D] Context source resolver closes over DiagramStore
|   |-- sourceId starts with repo- -> repositories.resolveCheckoutRoot

|   `-- Otherwise loadProject -> resolveDiagramSource -> binding().corpus

|-- [C] Cross-service callbacks wired at construction
|   |-- Agent Chat generations -> evalRuns.recordLegacy
|   |-- Legacy replay/cancel -> Agent Chat rerunAlternatives/cancelGeneration
|   |-- Catalog snapshot(id, checkpoint) -> evalRuns.outputSnapshot

    |-- Exported handle exposes routes, liveCanvas and workflow/integration services

MCP connection scope and HTTP translation
|-- [M] Startup inputs
|   |-- URL argument or MAPPING_URL; require HTTP(S)
|   |-- --canvas/--document or MAPPING_CANVAS_ID/MAPPING_DOCUMENT_ID
|   `-- MAPPING_CHAT_BINDING enables host-discovered chat tools
|-- [D] Exposed schemas depend on binding and tool kind
|   |-- Chat binding + diagram tool -> directBatchSchemas
|   |-- Other diagram tools -> object wrapper for single/batch arguments
|   `-- Binding or target -> exposed sessionId becomes optional
|-- [C/O] Target without chat binding -> lazy attachment
|   |-- Scoped call -> POST exec with generated canvas.attach(target) code
|   |-- Cache one Promise per server; rejection clears cache
|   |-- Inject resolved sessionId; conflicting supplied ID -> BINDING_MISMATCH
|   `-- Skip for changeSessionId or diagram-search with representationId
|-- [C] No chat binding -> validate diagram-tool args after scope resolution
|-- [C] Agent tools -> POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{name}
|   |-- Forward chat binding header when present; 65-second timeout
|   |-- HTTP success -> text plus structuredContent.result
|   `-- HTTP failure or exception -> isError
|-- [C/D] Bound chat discovery -> GET /api/mapping/agent-chat/tools
|   |-- 15-second timeout; host JSON schemas must become object schemas
|   `-- Register chat_{name} -> POST input and callId "mcp:<requestId>"
|       `-- Binding header; callId must be nonempty and at most 200 characters
`-- [M] Extra eval/comparison tools have separate fetch callbacks
    `-- These callbacks send JSON content type but no chat binding header

HTTP admission and error translation
|-- [C] Adapter claims /api and /internal prefixes
|   |-- Only /api/{core|mapping}/... can dispatch
|   `-- /internal is claimed but returns 404 in this adapter
|-- [D] Write gate = disabled HTTP + no truthy binding header + mutation
|   |-- Classifier examines /api/mapping/agent/tools/* only
|   |-- GET/HEAD/OPTIONS are not classified as mutations
|   |-- POST exemptions: list_repositories, get_repository_diff_hunks
|   |   |-- read_change_session_diff_tree, edit-diagram-status
|   |   `-- diagram-search, canvas-api-search
|   |-- MCP readOnlyHint is separate metadata with a broader read list
|   |   `-- list/read-agent-context hints do not exempt them from this gate
|   `-- Gate bypass alone does not establish binding validity
|       `-- Agent route passes string tokens to service.callBound
|-- [C] readBody buffers UTF-8 JSON; counts bytes, not characters
|   |-- Default 10 MiB; workspace operations and canvas reply allow 64 MiB
|   `-- Overflow -> clear buffer, reject RequestTooLarge, keep draining
|-- [C] Before headers: adapter maps errors to JSON
|   `-- 413 size; 409 conflict; 415 binary; 503 disabled/unavailable; else 400
|-- [C] After headers: newline JSON error -> end if open
`-- [C] Agent route catches errors before the adapter
    |-- Conflict strings -> 409; UNAVAILABLE -> 503; otherwise 400
    `-- Oversized reply -> 413; x-canvas-command-id can identify failed command
        `-- bridge.reply receives CANVAS_REPLY_REJECTED acknowledgement

Agent Chat: public views and stream ownership
|-- [M] Explicit publicSession projection
|   |-- Removes toolDefinitions and generationRequests
|   |-- Removes history from session.generation
|   `-- Used for create, resume, individual get and SSE snapshot
|-- [M] publicEvent filters selected event shapes
|   |-- snapshot -> publicSession; state generation patch -> publicGeneration
|   |-- batch -> recursively filter nested events
|   `-- Other events pass through; list/generations routes delegate directly
|-- [D] SSE snapshot derives compact tool items
|   |-- Only completed tool items with text or diff over 1000 characters
|   |-- Text: last 3 lines; diffs: first 3 lines; each line capped at 240
|   |-- detailAvailable = true; full item available via /sessions/{id}/items/{id}
|   `-- Multiple items -> empty partial snapshot then one snapshot-part per item
|       `-- Last part sets final = true
|-- [C/O] GET events -> verify session -> flush headers -> subscribe
|   |-- identity encoding; no-cache/no-transform; disable proxy buffering
|   |-- Heartbeat every 15 seconds
|   |-- Snapshot bytes temporarily extend the queue allowance
|   |   `-- Backpressure beyond allowance + 2 MiB -> destroy response
|   `-- Close -> clear heartbeat and unsubscribe
|       `-- Also clean up if response dies while awaiting subscribe
`-- [D] MCP origin uses request.socket.localPort
    `-- Constructs loopback URL without trusting Host/forwarded headers

Live canvas: roles, transport lifetime and read dependencies
|-- [C] attach/publish establishes role; earlier errors need not close socket
|   |-- Already bound or attaching -> ALREADY_ATTACHED
|   |-- attach -> optional contextForCanvas -> service.attach -> attached
|   |   |-- Reader: context.get, diagram.copy/paste, agent-context.upload
|   |   `-- context.get rejects while request pending or context bytes queued
|   `-- publish -> service.publish(capabilities) -> publisher.ready
|       |-- Ready frame advertises protocolVersion 2
|       `-- Publisher: selection update/remove and copy/paste replies
|-- [M] Separate socket options govern copy/paste and context uploads
|   `-- Vite sets both options from httpEnabled === true
|-- [O] Adapter tracks handshake, heartbeat and output queue
|   |-- Bind within 10 seconds; initial context fetch substitutes 30 seconds
|   |-- Ping every 15 seconds; missing pong or socket error -> terminate
|   |-- bufferedAmount > 64 KiB + contextAllowance -> close 1013
|   |-- Context frame > 64 MiB -> close 1009
|   |   `-- Otherwise add encoded bytes to allowance; send callback subtracts them
|   `-- Close -> clear handshake; detach reader or disconnect publisher
|-- [D] GET live/context/short
|   |-- Exactly one workspaceInstanceId and documentId, each 1-200 characters
|   |-- shortContextForCanvas -> body plus epoch/version headers; no-store
|   `-- Non-LiveCanvasError failure -> 503 CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE
`-- [D] GET live/connections/{id}/selection
    |-- service.read -> epoch, sequence, document version and received-at headers
    |-- connectionId + sequence -> quoted ETag
    `-- Match any comma-separated If-None-Match tag, stripping W/, or "*"
        `-- Match -> 304; otherwise 200 selection JSON; private, no-cache

Evaluation: request inputs, outputs and projections
|-- [C] POST runs / roll-ups -> runs.start / startRollUp -> 202
|-- [D] GET runs/{id}
|   |-- runs.read(id) -> summarizeEvalRun
|   `-- summary.id -> judgements.list -> add judgements only if nonempty
|-- [D] POST prompt-snapshots
|   `-- Strict UUID requestId + name (1-120) -> prompts.snapshot
|-- [D] POST prompts/{id}/fork
|   `-- Positive integer version + UUID requestId + name -> prompts.fork
|-- [D] POST runs/{id}/output-result
|   |-- Strict cellKey (1-300), changeSessionId (1-200), nonnegative expectedVersion
|   `-- runs.captureOutputResult(runId, input) -> JSON result
|-- [C] Output navigation
|   |-- GET output-result / promotion-source -> runId and cell query
|   |-- POST promote -> runs.promoteOutput
|   `-- POST placement-backfill -> runs.backfillPlacementTracking
|-- [M] History endpoint exposes a summary
|   `-- runs.histories.read(id) -> omit documents -> response
|-- [C] Experiments expose save/read, approve, judge and relaunch
|   `-- Approve/relaunch return 202; judge returns 200
`-- [M] Route delegates are conditional on supplied services
    |-- Evals require runs, prompts and references in mapping router
    `-- Bootstrap supplies these plus optional eval extensions
